result_text:
`all_files.zip` is now built from the configured aspect names instead of fixed literals, so renaming a scope aspect no longer drops it or `git-history.zip`.

In `DataExporter.java` in `reports/.../dataexporters`, the export builds the list of the five scope aspects in the usual order: main, test, generated, build and deployment, other. For each one it works out the file name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same helper that names the loose `aspect_*.txt` files. It then reads that file and adds it to the zip under that name.

With the default configuration the entries are unchanged. A renamed aspect now gets its own name in its place, so `buildAndDeployment` gives `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt` in fourth position. Because the zip no longer throws, the `git-history.zip` step that follows it also runs again.

The module compiles, and the `DataExport*` tests pass. I did not run a full export with a renamed aspect or add a test for it.
